---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("rest_inspec")

inspections = rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0,
    score <= 100,
    !is.na(boro),
    boro != "Missing"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    boro = factor(boro),
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "P", "Z", "Not Yet Graded"))
  ) |>
  slice_sample(n = 15000)
